workflow.description: An extraction agent reads the order parts; a Calculate node computes the total in code. Messages with no total are turned away before any approval decision; orders over $1,000 go to human review and the rest are approved.
workflow.name: Purchase routing

config.system: You read purchase requests. Whatever the message is (an order, a greeting, a question or anything else), respond with only one JSON object with the keys item, quantity, unit_price and total, and nothing else. item is the name of the product being bought, never a verb such as "buy" or "order". Copy each value exactly as the message states it, and use null for anything it does not state. If the message gives a price per item, put it in unit_price; if it gives one price for the whole order, put it in total. Never calculate a total yourself, and never guess. For "3 laptops at $450 each" respond {"item": "laptops", "quantity": 3, "unit_price": 450, "total": null}. For "a monitor for $1,200" respond {"item": "monitor", "quantity": null, "unit_price": null, "total": 1200}.

config.template:
Routed to human review: the order total is over $1,000. A manager must approve it before purchase.
Calculated: {message}

Auto-approved: the order total is $1,000 or less. No review needed.
Calculated: {message}

Not a purchase request: no order total was found, so nothing was approved or sent for review.
Message: {message}
